Индикатор показывает, где сейчас находят: The indicator shows where Russian retail investors' money currently sits in exchange-traded funds and which way it is moving between categories. For every fund we track how the value of its assets changes and how much money investors put in or take out.
Это «барометр настроения»: когда деньги: It is a sentiment barometer: when money flees en masse into safe instruments, the market is cautious; when it returns to equities, risk appetite is back.
Данные основаны на публичной информации: Data is based on public information from the Moscow Exchange.
Обновление — раз в торговый день, после: Updated once per trading day, after the close. Some funds report with a one- or two-day lag — such funds are flagged separately (see below).

Гистограмма чистого движения денег. Зелё: A histogram of net money movement. A green bar up means more money was added to funds than withdrawn over the step (net inflow). A red bar down means more was withdrawn (net outflow). This mode strips out price moves: it shows investor decisions, not asset revaluation.
Стоимость чистых активов — совокупный «д: Net asset value — the combined “money pool” of all funds in the category, as a line over time. Note that NAV grows both when investors add money and when fund assets simply appreciate. So this is an overview mode — actual money inflows are better seen in Inflows/Outflows.

Самое информативное — сопоставить СЧА, п: The most informative view is to compare NAV, flows and the benchmark index:
Категория «работает»: рост обусловлен и: The category is “working”: growth comes from both the market and money inflows. Healthy dynamics.
СЧА растёт, индекс стоит или падает: NAV rising, index flat or falling
Чистые притоки заметнее движения рынка —: Net inflows outweigh the market move — the NAV line outpaces the index. May indicate investors are adding money. For the money market this is the usual picture (growth through accrued interest).
Отток денег при растущем рынке — возможн: Money leaving while the market rises — possibly profit-taking or reallocation.
Заметный приток в фонды денежного рынка: Notable inflow into money market funds
Инвесторы чаще перекладываются в менее р: Investors are shifting into lower-risk instruments. May reflect caution in the market.
Может отражать возвращающийся аппетит к: May reflect returning risk appetite — especially if the money market sees outflows at the same time.
Может отражать снижение спроса на защитн: May reflect falling demand for the defensive asset. Sometimes coincides with an equity rally.
